glass.durability_notes: Rigid and scratch-resistant, but shatters on impact with no partial-failure mode — it either survives transit intact or breaks outright.
glass.sustainability_notes: Infinitely recyclable, but heavier than most alternatives — higher shipping-related carbon footprint per unit.
glass.recommended_packaging_notes: Requires a rigid outer box plus cushioning on all sides — bubble wrap alone is not sufficient for glass.

ceramic.durability_notes: Chip-prone at edges and corners; heat-tolerant in normal use but fails suddenly on impact, similar to glass.
ceramic.sustainability_notes: Long usable life if it survives transit intact — breakage in shipping, not wear, is the main lifecycle/waste concern.
ceramic.recommended_packaging_notes: Individual wrap per piece, plus rigid divider inserts for multi-piece sets.

electronic.durability_notes: Sensitive to moisture, drops, and static discharge; internal component quality is not visually inspectable at receipt.
electronic.sustainability_notes: E-waste disposal is a genuine downstream concern — reference cautiously in any brand sustainability story.
electronic.recommended_packaging_notes: Anti-static packaging plus foam inserts; never ship loose in a box alongside other items.

plastic.durability_notes: High impact tolerance; can discolor or become brittle under prolonged UV/heat exposure.
plastic.sustainability_notes: Rising customer sensitivity to single-use plastic — recycled or BPA-free claims are a real differentiation lever, but must be verifiable against a supplier certificate, not just stated.
plastic.recommended_packaging_notes: Standard poly mailer or corrugated box; packaging cost is low relative to other materials.

rubber.durability_notes: Flexible and tear-resistant; years of UV exposure can eventually cause brittleness or cracking.
rubber.sustainability_notes: Non-biodegradable, but a long usable life reduces replacement frequency relative to more disposable materials.
rubber.recommended_packaging_notes: Minimal cushioning needed — one of the lowest packaging-cost materials in this catalog.

fabric.durability_notes: Susceptible to tearing, staining, and colour fade over time; care-instruction accuracy directly affects return rate.
fabric.sustainability_notes: Organic/sustainable-fabric claims are a genuine, high-customer-sensitivity differentiator — but only if backed by a verifiable supplier certificate.
fabric.recommended_packaging_notes: Poly bag or padded mailer — compressible, so shipping cost is comparatively low.

leather.durability_notes: Long usable life if genuine; synthetic ('PU leather') wears and cracks noticeably faster — misrepresentation between the two is a common source of complaints.
leather.sustainability_notes: Genuine leather draws real sustainability scrutiny — verify and disclose genuine vs. synthetic clearly rather than leaving it ambiguous.
leather.recommended_packaging_notes: Dust bag plus rigid box for structured items such as bags and wallets.

metal.durability_notes: High structural durability; added weight increases shipping cost meaningfully, and some finishes scratch or corrode over time.
metal.sustainability_notes: Highly recyclable — frequently positioned as a premium, durable alternative to plastic.
metal.recommended_packaging_notes: Corrugated box with edge protectors — weight drives packaging/shipping cost more than fragility does here.

wood.durability_notes: Durable with proper finishing; untreated wood is susceptible to moisture warping and pest damage.
wood.sustainability_notes: Bamboo is fast-renewing and a strong sustainability differentiator if responsibly sourced; hardwood sustainability claims should be independently verified.
wood.recommended_packaging_notes: Corrugated box with void fill — corners are the most common transit-damage point.

paper.durability_notes: Low moisture and impact tolerance; typically used for low-value or single-use items rather than durable goods.
paper.sustainability_notes: The strongest sustainability story of any material in this catalog — genuinely recyclable and biodegradable.
paper.recommended_packaging_notes: Often ships within its own structure with minimal extra packaging — protect from moisture in transit.
